req.title: Delete post
req.statement: The system shall remove the post row and redirect to / when POST /<id>/delete is issued by the post's author.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to verify the functionality of deleting a post in the Flaskr application. It includes a positive test to ensure the post is deleted successfully, a negative test to handle unauthorized deletion attempts, and a boundary test to check behavior when attempting to delete a non-existent post.

tests.name: test_delete_post_success
actions: Send POST request to /<id>/delete with valid post ID
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login user
data = {'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'}
client.post('/auth/register', data=data)
client.post('/auth/login', data=data)

# Create a post
post_data = {'title': 'Test Post', 'body': 'This is a test.'}
client.post('/create', data=post_data)

# Get post ID
r = client.get('/')
post_id = r.data.decode().split('href="/')[1].split('/')[0]

# Delete the post
r = client.post(f'/{post_id}/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_delete_post_unauthorized
preconditions: Another user has created a post
actions: Send POST request to /<id>/delete with valid post ID of another user
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login first user
data1 = {'username': 'user1', 'password': 'pass1'}
client.post('/auth/register', data=data1)
client.post('/auth/login', data=data1)

# Create a post by first user
post_data = {'title': 'User1 Post', 'body': 'This is user1 post.'}
client.post('/create', data=post_data)

# Logout first user
client.get('/auth/logout')

# Register and login second user
data2 = {'username': 'user2', 'password': 'pass2'}
client.post('/auth/register', data=data2)
client.post('/auth/login', data=data2)

# Attempt to delete first user's post
r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 403

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_post
actions: Send POST request to /<id>/delete with non-existent post ID
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login user
data = {'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'}
client.post('/auth/register', data=data)
client.post('/auth/login', data=data)

# Attempt to delete a non-existent post
r = client.post('/999/delete')
assert r.status_code == 404
